title: The Most Profitable One-Man Business You’ve Never Heard Of
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: So, a lot of people didn't know about this kind of business and they were [music] paying tree services lots and lots of money to do it by hand.
stated_problem.speaker: Alex

idea.name: Residential forestry mulching and land clearing
idea.one_liner: Use a financed skid steer with a forestry mulcher to clear overgrown residential land (e.g. invasive honeysuckle), found via long-tail keyword research and sold through Facebook video ads that funnel to an educational YouTube channel
idea.customer: rural and suburban landowners with overgrown acreage
idea.offer: forestry mulching/land clearing priced per quarter acre by brush density and terrain tier

key_quotes.quote: So the way we do our pricing is by the quarter acre.
So, the three-step marketing framework is capture, educate, sale.
They're basically already sold by the time that I even go out there because they've already seen it all through our YouTube channel.

claims.claim: $6,000 job yields ~$4,000 profit with paid operator
claims.quote: We charge $750 to run the grapple. So $6,000 job, $4,000 profit.
But yeah, this year we ended up doing about 565,000 in 6 months.
Uh, first 30 days, I think it was about 25,000.
So, our per lead cost is $20.
Um, I would say with one person, one machine running year round, they could do reasonably about 35,000 a month.

claims.claim: Used mulcher head $15k; $5k down to finance machine
claims.quote: So, we definitely financed, you know, we put about 5,000 down um and financed the first machine.

acquisition_channels.details: local radius, started at $20/day now ~$80/day, link to YouTube and website
educational before/after videos shot on own property
long-tail consumer terms like 'clear my woods', 'get rid of honeysuckle'

ideas.delivery: Owner quotes and marks area; one operator ($250-300/day) runs skid steer with mulcher; ~$80-100/day diesel; 8-10% set aside for repairs; 20% deposit over $10k; offer 10% discount to shift jobs into winter
ideas.other_uk_rules: Felling licence from Forestry Commission if felling >5 cubic metres per quarter; Wildlife and Countryside Act nesting-bird restrictions; check TPOs/conservation areas; waste rules for removed material

idea.name: Snow removal subcontracting with skid steers
idea.one_liner: Use skid steers with snow boxes to clear commercial lots as subcontractors to general contractors who hold snow contracts with trigger depths
idea.customer: general contractors and commercial property owners
idea.revenue_model: per snow event / hourly via GC

key_quotes.quote: So if you've got one machine, let's say, and you've just got to clear some snow and you get a good season of snow, you've essentially just paid for that machine for the whole year.
I mean, general contractors, what they do is they capture the snow contract.

claims.quote: So if you get a good snow event, so we'll make around 10 to $11,000 per snow event and that is within about 20 hours of clearing
